notes: The valuation-band trios (P/E, P/S, EV/EBITDA) and the model band-trio quick-add still used the pre-4.72 silent staged toggle — clicking gave no feedback and no config, which read as "not selectable." Group rows now SELECT into the config column like everything else: the panel lists the set's refs and offers ＋ Add all / ✕ Remove all (taking effect on OK), with the note that each staged member is then individually configurable from Displayed. One interaction grammar, now genuinely everywhere.
